page_title: PAR 1-1 FIO | Parma v Fiorentina 17/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Giovanni Ayroldi has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Dodo, but Zion Suzuki displays great awareness to stop him.
90+3' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' Big chance! A simple pass from Pontus Almqvist left Wylan Cyprien (Parma) with just the keeper to beat inside the box, but his shot went agonisingly just past the left post.
85' Alessandro Circati (Parma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Giovanni Ayroldi had an easy-decision to make.
83' The game is help up as Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) is shown a red card, following two cautions, and has to leave the pitch.

82' Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) and his stunning dribble! He zig-zags through the defence and gets in front of the keeper. He faints to shoot and then suddenly strikes goalwards, but his effort misses the target by a whisker. Very unlucky for Michael Kayode (Fiorentina). This could have been a legendary goal.
80' Fabio Pecchia has decided to substitute Adrian Bernabe Garcia and he is replaced by Wylan Cyprien (Parma).
79' The game has come to an end for Christian Kouame. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina).
78' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

78' Sofyan Amrabat (Fiorentina) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball goes out of play. Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.
78' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) brings an opponent down and Giovanni Ayroldi interrupts the game. Fiorentina have a free kick.
76' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Simon Sohm.
75' 1 - 1 Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) changes the score with his amazing free kick from just outside the box. The shot went in, bouncing off the left post and left the goalkeeper no chance at all.
73' Here is a change. Rolando Mandragora is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Alessandro Bianco (Fiorentina).
73' The substitution has been made. Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) has replaced Pietro Comuzzo.
71' The referee blows for a cooling break.
71' Dodo (Fiorentina) whips a volley from long range towards the goal. His beautiful effort whistles wide of the right post. It was close and it could have been a top class goal!
71' The corner from Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is intercepted by Zion Suzuki.

70' Dodo (Fiorentina) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The linesman points to the corner flag, Fiorentina are going to take it.
68' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) unleashes a sweet first-timer from the edge of the box to the left side of the goal. The goalkeeper stops the shot with a quick save.
65' Substitution. Ange-Yoan Bonny makes way for Antoine Hainaut (Parma).
65' A substitution has been made. Valentin Mihaila goes off and Drissa Camara (Parma) comes on.
65' Fabio Pecchia has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pontus Almqvist (Parma) replacing Dennis Man.
63' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is caught offside once again.
63' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) brings down the pass, looks up and shoots from distance, but it's straight at a defender who unwittingly blocks it.
62' Sofyan Amrabat (Fiorentina) is penalised for holding. Giovanni Ayroldi signals a set piece.
60' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Lucas Martinez Quarta will be replaced by Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina).
60' Substitution. Andrea Colpani did his best and is replaced by Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina).
59' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
58' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
56' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) takes the corner with a short pass.
56' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Fiorentina earn a corner.

54' What an opportunity! Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the right post!
53' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
52' Woyo Coulibaly (Parma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Parma.
49' Botond Balogh (Parma) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.

47' Woyo Coulibaly (Parma) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Pietro Terracciano gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
46' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle as Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
43' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

43' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) inside the box and he manages to steer it to the left side of the target. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Zion Suzuki makes a save in the nick of time and maintains the current score. The linesman makes the right call and Fiorentina will have a corner.
43' The ball is out of play. Fiorentina will have a chance to score from a corner.

42' What a great touch by Moise Kean (Fiorentina) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the centre of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Fiorentina force a corner. They send men into the box.
38' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Dodo (Fiorentina) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
36' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nahuel Estevez (Parma) was quite harsh and Giovanni Ayroldi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
36' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
35' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
34' The total number of attempts is 9:6. 4:4 – this is the current number of shots on target.
32' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
32' Simon Sohm (Parma) sends a superb lead pass into the penalty area and finds Emanuele Valeri, who fails to shoot. Parma will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
29' Dennis Man (Parma) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
29' Dennis Man (Parma) takes a short corner kick.
28' Simon Sohm (Parma) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the right post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
28' Simon Sohm (Parma) fires a rebound from close range onto the bar!
26' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
25' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Zion Suzuki gets down to his right to keep it out.
22' 1 - 0 Goal! Ange-Yoan Bonny tees up Dennis Man (Parma) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the top left corner. 1:0.
21' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
20' Dennis Man (Parma) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Pietro Terracciano intercepts the ball.

18' Zion Suzuki makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the left side of the target.
16' The corner from Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is hurriedly cleared.
15' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) prepares to take a corner kick.
15' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance. Good work from Fiorentina as they win a corner.
15' Dodo (Fiorentina) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Fiorentina.
13' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Pietro Terracciano comes off the line to clear the ball away.
10' Dodo (Fiorentina) latches onto a cross into the box from the wing and gets in a header. It went well towards the goal, but it was blocked by one of the defenders.
7' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

6' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) takes a nice touch on the edge of the box as he meets a pass and produces a shot towards the roof of the net. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper! Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.

4' Simon Sohm (Parma) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom left corner. Pietro Terracciano is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. Valentin Mihaila (Parma) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot just over the bar. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!

4' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the left-hand post. However, he couldn't beat Pietro Terracciano, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Fiorentina will take the kick-off.
Giovanni Ayroldi was nominated as the referee for this game.
